faq_heading: Homes near Regent Christian Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Regent Christian Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Regent Christian Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Regent Christian Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Regent Christian Academy, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Regent Christian Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cambridge Elementary (1.1 km south), T E Scott Elementary (1.1 km north-west) and Sullivan Elementary (1.3 km south).

How the Regent Christian Academy search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Regent Christian Academy, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Regent Christian Academy

The closest is Cambridge Elementary, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Fleetwood Park Secondary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Cambridge Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest secondary school is Sullivan Heights Secondary (1.6 km).
